fixtureMethod: Generated JSONL records from deterministic per-row xorshift32 seeds; source files written to OPFS in <=32 KiB encoded chunks; each requested target is rounded down to a complete JSONL record.

memoryMeasurement.pageHeap: performance.memory sampled every 50 ms when exposed; page realm only.
memoryMeasurement.workerHeap: Worker instrumentation reports API exposure and sampled heap only when exposed.
memoryMeasurement.processMemory: Not inferred from page/worker values; Android process diagnostic access checked separately.
memoryMeasurement.deviceMemory: navigator.deviceMemory is a coarse browser hint, not measured free RAM.
